request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Turn it into a stone-age log raft: the pale hull becomes tied logs of warm tawny wood, colour #a2804b with #6e4f26 shadows; a small carved plesiosaur head painted deep blue #205794 with orange stripes at the front; the red tarp becomes dull sandy brown animal hide, colour #a67c3d, with big bold dark brown spots; the pennant becomes three orange feathers. Keep the oars, boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
